title: oenothera strigosa var. cheradophila
intro: Oenothera strigosa var. cheradophila, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species in the Onagraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera strigosa var. cheradophila include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects. Its bioactive constituents include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid that may also contribute to its therapeutic actions.
